airport.name: Brigadier Mayor D Cesar Raul Ojeda Airport

summary: Brigadier Mayor D Cesar Raul Ojeda Airport serves the city of San Luis, the capital of San Luis Province in central-western Argentina. The airport primarily handles domestic flights, connecting the region to Buenos Aires and other major Argentine cities. It supports both commercial passenger service and general aviation activity for this scenic Andean foothills region.
faqs:
Q: What airlines operate from Brigadier Mayor D Cesar Raul Ojeda Airport?
A: The airport is primarily served by Aerolíneas Argentinas and its subsidiary Austral, offering regular flights mainly to Buenos Aires Aeroparque.

Q: How far is the airport from downtown San Luis?
A: The airport is located approximately 3-4 kilometers north of San Luis city center, making it a quick drive of around 10 minutes.

Q: Does the airport have international flights?
A: No, the airport primarily handles domestic flights, with no scheduled international service at this time.

Q: Are there car rental services at the airport?
A: Yes, local car rental agencies operate at the airport, though availability can be limited so advance booking is recommended.
transport_tips: Taxis and remise (radio taxi) services are readily available outside the terminal and offer the most convenient transfer to San Luis city center. Public bus routes also connect the airport area to the city, though they run on limited schedules. Rental cars are available but booking in advance is advisable, especially during off-peak times.
local_tip: If you have time before your flight, visit the nearby Sierra de las Quijadas National Park, about 100 km northwest, which features dramatic red-rock landscapes and dinosaur fossil sites unique to the region.
